A: 11, 7, 8, 6, 3, 1

At least one robot must improve for a successful exchange. Your task is to choose all six goals to form such a mutually beneficial exchange. Staying with your initial goal is allowed. Robot paths visualize assignment costs only; collisions and travel timing are not part of this game.

Return exactly one JSON object containing only "goals": an array of six goal letters, in robot order A, B, C, D, E, F. For example {"goals":["A","B","C","D","E","F"]}. Allowed goal values: A, B, C, D, E, F. Do not include explanatory text.
